transitions.when: source == 'ai' and ((action == 'cooling_on' and facts.heater == 'on') or (action == 'heater_on' and facts.cooling_unit == 'cool'))
source == 'ai' and action == 'cooling_on' and facts.heater != 'on' and facts.cooling_unit == 'off' and active.rest and clock.rest < params.rest_s

source == 'ai' and not ((action == 'cooling_on' and facts.heater == 'on') or (action == 'heater_on' and facts.cooling_unit == 'cool')) and not (action == 'cooling_on' and facts.cooling_unit == 'off' and active.rest and clock.rest < params.rest_s)

properties.expression: not (source == 'ai' and outcome == 'allow' and ((action == 'cooling_on' and facts.heater == 'on') or (action == 'heater_on' and facts.cooling_unit == 'cool')))
not (source == 'ai' and outcome == 'allow' and action == 'cooling_on' and facts.cooling_unit == 'off' and active.rest and clock.rest < params.rest_s)
outcome == 'allow' or (before.cooling_unit == after.cooling_unit and before.heater == after.heater and before.fan == after.fan and before.light == after.light)

kind != 'proposal' or source != 'ai' or outcome != 'block' or ((action == 'cooling_on' and facts.heater == 'on') or (action == 'heater_on' and facts.cooling_unit == 'cool') or (action == 'cooling_on' and facts.cooling_unit == 'off' and active.rest and clock.rest < params.rest_s))
source == 'ai' and outcome == 'allow' and action == 'cooling_on' and active.rest and clock.rest >= params.rest_s
